title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1966-10-31

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a decent‑sounding instrumental jam, but the performance is almost certainly by an unknown group rather than the Grateful Dead.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its clear, “5‑star” sound and tight instrumental feel, yet reviewers overwhelmingly agree it isn’t a genuine Dead set – most point to mismatched guitar phrasing, bass line, and an overly fast tempo. The fragmentary five‑minute track leaves listeners wanting the rest of the show, and while the jam (notably a Viola Lee Blues vibe) is enjoyable, it lacks the energy and signature dynamics of a classic Dead performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Recording quality is solid (soundboard, good clarity), but the musical content is judged not to be the Grateful Dead and receives low show ratings; overall average of reviewer stars yields a modest rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑balanced sound noted as “5 star”; no major dropouts or noise complaints.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Only a short five‑minute fragment is present; reviewers lament the missing remainder of the performance.
